name: Interviews & References
description: Management calls, customer references and expert calls. What was said is logged as claims, with a note of how far the claims match the evidence — an interview is a source of claims, never of facts by itself.

agentPrompts.label: Log this call
agentPrompts.body: Read the `busa-vc-diligence` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then log the call I describe: who it was with (role, not just a name), the key claims they made, and the follow-ups. Mark every claim's consistency as Not yet tested until it has been checked against the Evidence Register.

agentPrompts.label: Test this interview's claims against the evidence
agentPrompts.body: Read the `busa-vc-diligence` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then take the interview I name and test each key claim against the Evidence Register for that target: mark the interview's consistency Consistent, Partly consistent, Contradicts evidence, or still Not yet tested, and name the evidence behind the verdict. Do not change the claims themselves.

agentPrompts.label: Who have we not heard from yet?
agentPrompts.body: Read the `busa-vc-diligence` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then for the target I name, tell me which reference voices are missing — no customer, no expert, no former employee — judged against the claims the investment thesis depends on. Do not change anything.

views.name: All interviews
views.description: Every call logged on the desk

views.name: Not yet tested
views.description: Interviews whose claims have not been checked against evidence
